name: vivid-clinic-reviews
description: Patient review landing page for Vivid Clinic (vivid.clinic) — built from authorized Google Business Profile review data.

scripts.refresh: npm run import && npm run import:media && npm run validate && npm run build
scripts.serve: node --version >/dev/null && (command -v python3 >/dev/null && python3 -m http.server 8787 --directory dist || npx --yes serve dist -l 8787)
